derivation:
by
  simpa only [cubeVertices, Finset.image_nonempty] using (Finset.subsetSum_nonempty (A := S.image fun v => Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)))
explanation: Instantiate subsetSum_nonempty with the finite set of basis vectors. Unfolding cubeVertices reduces the result to nonemptiness of an image of that subset-sum set.
